Good afternoon, and welcome to race day! The race starts at two o'clock. Each driver does seventy laps. The pit lane opens at one thirty. Every team has one minute for a test in the pit lane. Please stay behind the yellow line. The track is very hot today, so the tires are very important. Enjoy the race!

Hi, I'm Marco, and I'm a mechanic on a Formula 1 crew. My job is the front left tire. In a pit stop, I change it in about two seconds. I travel to more than twenty countries every year. I don't drive the car, of course. The driver drives, and I work in the garage. I love my job, but I don't see my family a lot.
